fact: Telegraph Egypt reported on 2025-06-18 that Starlink was not yet activated in Egypt, that selling or marketing it requires an official licence not yet held, and that talks with the ministry were under way; smuggled terminals are an offence under Article 77 of the telecom law, with confiscation.
A Starlink availability table lists Egypt as 'No planned launch date', so Starlink was not on sale in Egypt; the article's date is used as it gives none for this entry.
The article lists Egypt's Starlink status as unknown and says Egypt, with Ethiopia, restricts or blocks the service to protect state-owned telecoms; article date used.
The article places Egypt among countries in regulatory limbo for Starlink, neither approved nor explicitly banned, so no approval is stated; article date used.
